title: adenocalymma biternatum
intro: Adenocalymma biternatum, commonly known as "Cupuaçu do campo", is a plant species belonging to the Bignoniaceae family, native to the Brazilian savanna. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and infections. The bioactive constituents of Adenocalymma biternatum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-anxiety and anti-depressive effects, and its ability to modulate the immune system.
